columns.name: status
columns.description: proposed (waiting for them, or for auto-post) -> approved (by them) -> posting -> commented; or liked, skipped, failed.

columns.name: posted_via
columns.description: teammate (they approved it), auto (auto-post was on; nobody approved this one), by_hand (they posted it themselves), assistant (imported from outside the pod).

columns.name: first_draft
columns.description: The comment exactly as the teammate first drafted it. Never changed after that, so the person's edits (comment_draft vs first_draft) can be learned from.

columns.name: signal
columns.description: For replies to the person (method thread or own_post): what kind of reply it is. hot: wants to try it, asked for a DM or a link. question: asked something. pushback: disagreed. agree: agreed and added their own point. ack: a short thanks or emoji. ignore: bot test, spam, insult or a competitor's plug.

columns.name: lane
columns.description: Why it was picked: ask, warm, world, climbing, topic, peer, reply.

columns.name: checked_visible
columns.description: After posting, the comment was seen under the post on a reload. false stops all LinkedIn work.
